summary: Petition seeking approval under Section 17 (3) and (4) of the Electricity Act, 2003 for bringing on record the appointment of IDBI Trusteeship Services Limited – Respondent No. 2 as a Security Trustee and for creation of security interest by way of hypothecation over the assets of Petitioner and pledge of 51% equity share capital of the Petitioner held by the promoter in favour of the IDBI Trusteeship Services Limited – Respondent No. 2 acting on behalf of and for the benefit of the lenders – Respondent Nos. 3 to 5 (and for any subsequent transferees, assign, novatees thereof and any refinancing lenders to the Project), pursuant to the Facility Agreement dated 20.03.2026, the Security Trustee Agreement dated 20.03.2026, the unattested Deed of Hypothecation dated 20.3.2026 and Agreement for Pledge of Shares dated 20.3.2026, Sponsor’s Undertaking dated 20.3.2026 and other financing agreements, for the development of the Transmission Project. - _(c) Grant approval under Section 17 (3) and (4) of the Electricity Act, 2003 for the creation of security interest, by way of hypothecation over the movable and immovable assets of the Petitioner and pledge of 51% equity share capital of the Petitioner held by the promoter, to the extent and in the manner mentioned in the Facility Agreement dated 20.03.2026, the Security Trustee Agreement dated 20.03.2026, the unattested Agreement for Pledge of Shares dated 20.03.2026, the unattested Deed of Hypothecation dated 20.03.2026, the Sponsor’s Undertaking dated 20.03.2026 and other financing documents, in favour of Security Trustee/ Respondent No. 2 acting on behalf of and for the benefit of the Lenders and for subsequent transferees, assigns, novates thereof and any refinancing lenders of the Transmission Project;_ - _(d) Approve any future security creation, over the movable and immovable assets of the Petitioner, in favour of Security Trustee acting on behalf of and for the benefit of the Lenders and for subsequent transferees, assigns, novates thereof and any refinancing lenders of the Project, by way of hypothecation and equitable mortgage on Project assets, pursuant to the requisite Financing Agreements executed in this regard; and_ - _(e) Pass such other order/orders, as may be deemed fit and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case.”_ (e) After execution of the Facility Agreement, the Lenders desired that the Petitioner (Borrower) set up a trust for the beneficial interest of the Lenders and empower the Security Trustee to act in the interest of the Lenders and execute financing documents and exercise certain rights and duties in relation thereto. Thereafter, at the request of the Petitioner (Borrower) and with the concurrence of the Lenders, Respondent No. 2, i.e., IDBI Trusteeship Services Limited, agreed to act as Security Trustee for the Lenders, including their assigns, transferees and novates. Accordingly, on 20.3.2026, Respondent No. 2 entered into a Security Trustee Agreement and other requisite financing documents with the Petitioner, including the unattested Deed of Hypothecation dated 20.3.2026, the unattested Agreement for Pledge of Shares dated 20.3.2026, the Trust and Retention Account Agreement dated 20.3.2026 and the Sponsor’s Undertaking dated 20.3.2026, in order to hold the security interest for benefit and on behalf of the Lenders . 4. The Petitioner has submitted that pursuant to the terms of the Facility Agreement (Clause 3.1), it is required to create the necessary security interest in favour of the Respondent No. 2, i.e., IDBI Trusteeship Services Limited. 5. In terms of the provision of the Facility Agreement, the Petitioner has submitted that it is required to create a security interest, _inter alia_ , as follows: (a) A first charge by way of mortgage on all the immovable fixed assets, including but not limited to land, civil structures, towers and cables, office buildings, both present and future, of the Petitioner. (e) A first pari passu charge by way of hypothecation/assignment of all rights, interest and title of the Petitioner under the Project Documents (as defined in the Facility Agreement), contracts, insurance contracts, clearances/approvals etc. related to the Transmission Project, to which the Petitioner is a party and can be legally assigned. 9. The matter was admitted on 13.5.2026, and notices were issued to the parties to file their respective replies. 10. During the hearing, the learned counsel for the Petitioner submitted that no reply has been filed by the Respondents despite notice. After hearing the learned counsel for the Petitioner, the matter was reserved for orders. 11. We have considered the submissions made by the Petitioner and perused the material available on record. The Petitioner has entered into the Facility Agreement dated 20.3.2026 with the Lenders to avail financial assistance aggregating Rs. 1,959.84 crore for the implementation of the Transmission Project. Further, the Lenders entered into a Security Trustee Agreement dated 20.03.2026 wherein they have appointed Respondent No. 2/ IDBI Trusteeship Services Limited, as the Security Trustee for the purpose of holding the security interest and holding the securities on behalf of and for the benefit of the Lenders (or their assignees, novatees or transferees). _“17. (3) No licensee shall any time assign his licence or transfer his utility, or any part hereof, by sale, lease, exchange or otherwise without the prior approval of the Appropriate Commission._ and immovable assets of the Petitioner and pledge of 51% equity share capital of the Petitioner held by the promoter. The Petitioner is directed to submit a signed copy of the Indenture of Mortgage for the Project immediately after its execution.
